title: Signal Definition Enrichment
description: Optional signal-definition enrichment fields that may be projected inline on signal listings when requested through get_signals.fields. This schema intentionally excludes signal identity and required definition fields so source-native, private, or compact listings can include typed partial disclosure without becoming a full adagents.json signal definition.

restricted_attributes.description: Restricted attribute categories this signal touches.

demographic_predicate.description: Projected authoritative demographic meaning for the signal. When projected from another provider, this MUST match the provider's definition exactly. Signal names alone never establish demographic semantics.

age_determination_bases.description: User-level bases by which the ages of this signal's members were established: verified, declared, and/or inferred. Sibling of demographic_predicate, not nested in it; only valid when demographic_predicate.age is present. Population estimates are out of scope (aggregate composition cannot establish an individual's age; use audience_evidence). Absent means the signal makes no basis claim (for a listing that projects a data_provider or signal_source definition, resolve the value from that definition; only the resolved value counts), and a buyer whose request names accepted_bases MUST NOT treat a signal with no resolved basis as satisfying the age predicate. A signal satisfies a requested age predicate with accepted_bases only when its demographic_predicate.age is within the request AND every value in age_determination_bases is in accepted_bases. The bases describe how known ages were established; unknown-age membership is governed only by include_unknown. Forward note: when gender targeting (#7925, experimental) graduates, gender will need an equivalent disclosure; this field is age-specific and the enum is not generalized. When projected from another provider, this MUST match the provider's definition exactly, the same rule demographic_predicate follows.

policy_categories.description: Policy categories this signal is sensitive for.

taxonomy.description: Optional taxonomy metadata describing what this signal means in an external audience, content, retail-media, or provider-owned taxonomy.

consent_basis.description: Data provider's declared GDPR Article 6 lawful basis or consent basis for the underlying signal definition, projected into this get_signals response row when requested. Sellers and federating agents that pass through another provider's signal MUST NOT substitute their own processing basis for the provider-declared basis.

art9_basis.description: Data provider's declared GDPR Article 9 basis for the underlying signal definition when special-category data is involved and Article 9 applies, projected into this get_signals response row when requested. Sellers and federating agents that pass through another provider's signal MUST NOT substitute their own Article 9 basis for the provider-declared basis.

data_subject_rights.description: Per-signal data-subject-rights routing. This is a contact/routing reference, not a machine-callable AdCP API.

last_updated.description: When this definition record was last updated. This indicates freshness of the definition record, not an attestation that the underlying data or model was refreshed at that time.

allOf.description: age_determination_bases qualifies demographic_predicate.age and is invalid without it.
